theses.line: Picks and shovels, but for vibes.
Money wants to be programmable. Regulators want a word.
The body is the last unmonetized subscription surface.
Fix the planet, hedge with a spare.
Players already pay for hats. Imagine if the hats appreciated.
If people chew it daily, it's recurring revenue.
The doctor will see your data now.
We only fund software boring enough to survive.
Escapism is a growth market; orbit is the premium tier.
Civilization runs on lunch and weather. We're long both.
Attention is finite. We'd like all of it.
Send the robots first. Invoice the humans after.
